voice.kern: txtme.social speaks to people who feel mentally drained by modern internet culture but still trapped inside it.
gefuehl: a thought you weren’t ready to hear
someone saying the quiet part out loud
voice.grenze: The brand can be confrontational, but never fake-edgy or try-hard.
schluss: It knows it’s part of the same system it critiques.
